column1: # INFORMACION MATRIMONIAL, Arzobispado de Buenos Aires - Nuestra Senora del Socorro, Retiro.
# Folio 44, 25 March 1914. Index ark 1:1:XWGW-RN7N; image ark 3:1:939D-GD76-B.
# *** TWO CORRECTIONS TO THIS ARCHIVE'S OWN ROW, both now settled on the image. ***
#   1. The register called this a "Retiro BAPTISM". It is an INFORMACION MATRIMONIAL - the sworn
#      pre-marriage enquiry - which is why it names both parties' parents and baptismal parishes.
#   2. The register read the father as "ALBERTO (almost certainly GILBERTO)". *** IT IS GILBERTO,
#      written plainly. *** The archive's own guess was right and can stop being a guess.

column2: En Buenos Aires, a veinte y cinco de Marzo de mil novecientos catorce
Don CARLOS LERENA, natural de la Rep. Oriental
*** "bautizado en la Iglesia de el CORDON, Dep. de Montevideo" ***
column3: *** A THIRD MONTEVIDEO PARISH for this family *** - after San Francisco de Asis and the Catedral Basilica. It names exactly where to find his baptism act.

column2: de treinta anos de edad, de estado soltero
column3: Thirty in March 1914, so born about 1884 - matching "Carlos A. Lerena, 11, born Uruguay" in Gilberto's Buenos Aires household at the 1895 census.
A Buenos Aires address for Gilberto's son.

column2: *** "hijo de D. GILBERTO LERENA y de Dona JULIA SALVANACH" ***
column3: *** THE FATHER IS GILBERTO. *** So Gilberto - now documented as Luis Eugenio's brother - has a son marrying in Buenos Aires in 1914, and this archive's Carlos row is his.

column2: Dona ROSA MARIA EPPENS, natural del Pais, bautizada en la Iglesia de Sn. Pedro, Provin. de Bs. Aires, de veinticinco anos de edad, de estado soltera
column3: Confirms the CEMLA pairing already recorded here: "Carlos Lerena 41 Uruguayan" and "Rosa M. E. Lerena 39 Argentine" arriving Buenos Aires from Montevideo, 27 May 1926.
